lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Files_Snapshots\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
2 uses of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

1 class implements or extends what the public API marks #[Consumable] in a major of Nextcloud 34 to 35: an app calls it, and the server may add a method to it in any release, which breaks a class that implements it.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 1 place. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 6 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
